guidance.title: Sources and requirements
guidance.static: Static guidance, not a live availability check. Unobserved items remain selectable; previews use fixed samples.
guidance.version_unknown: Minimum host version: not verified; no version boundary is inferred.
guidance.setup: Setup and diagnostic entry points (run explicitly; restart Claude Code after integration changes)
guidance.scopes.main_context: Current main context occupancy, not cumulative API usage
guidance.scopes.all_sessions: Recorded main and nested-agent usage, deduplicated
guidance.scopes.task: The human task, including owned agents and main wrap-up where applicable
guidance.scopes.subagent: This subagent only; no main-conversation fallback
guidance.scopes.subagent_context: This subagent context occupancy, not cumulative usage
guidance.scopes.latest_request: Latest main-thread request, not the whole task
guidance.requirements.observed_field: The source must provide valid values. Missing data is not zero.
guidance.requirements.subagent_rows: Subagent rows require Claude Code 2.1.205+, an installed renderer and enabled custom rows.
guidance.requirements.agent_context: Requires this task’s context fields and a valid capacity for percentages; agent tokens describe context occupancy.
guidance.requirements.configured_effort: Requires explicit tasks.effort on 2.1.214+; inherited effort can be absent and configured effort may differ from effective effort.
guidance.requirements.agent_effort_optio: The model can appear without effort. Optional tasks.effort requires 2.1.214+ and an explicit configured value.
guidance.requirements.git_repository: Requires an accessible local Git repository. Collection is local and cached; it does not fetch remotes.
guidance.requirements.git_upstream: Requires a configured upstream; synchronized counts are zero, while a removed upstream is reported as gone.
guidance.requirements.git_base: Compares committed HEAD with merge-base(base, HEAD), excluding uncommitted edits. Auto base tries origin/HEAD, main, then master.
guidance.requirements.pull_request: Requires an observed open pull/merge request for the current branch; this item does not call a hosting API.
guidance.requirements.worktree_session: Requires worktree metadata from a --worktree session.
guidance.requirements.usage_records: Requires recorded main/subagent usage. Raw counters are summed before formatting; partial or missing counters are not fabricated.
guidance.requirements.task_observation: Requires a task identity and reliable lifecycle observations. Queuing, owned agents and wrap-up follow the existing task contract.
guidance.requirements.native_timing: Requires native timing on a verified compatible host and the runtime Mod loaded after restarting Claude Code. Selecting the item does not enable collection.
guidance.requirements.complete_waits: Execution time excludes verified user waits and remains hidden when task/wait coverage or clocks are incomplete.
guidance.requirements.live_metrics: Requires install --live-metrics on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and a loaded runtime Mod. Advanced collection is independently opt-in.
guidance.requirements.owned_agents: Only agents/requests with verified task ownership count. Unknown ownership remains partial or unavailable.
guidance.requirements.checklist_events: Requires successful structured Task/Todo observations; completed/total is checklist coverage, not elapsed-task percentage.
guidance.requirements.tool_events: Requires an observed main-thread tool start and any available completion result.
guidance.requirements.complete_stream: Requires real host-referenced stream observations. Output rate also needs official output usage and the complete request duration, including first-content wait.
guidance.requirements.request_coverage: Requests are deduplicated and reconciled across owned agents and main wrap-up; incomplete coverage is marked partial.
guidance.requirements.existing_telemetry: Requires existing official api_request cost observations. No exporter is enabled or redirected, and no model-price estimate or session-cost delta is substituted.
guidance.requirements.gateway: Requires the gateway to provide its optional spend window.
guidance.requirements.gateway_284: Requires both host and gateway 2.1.284+ and the optional amount/period fields. Estimates may lag and are not derived from percentages.
guidance.requirements.valid_window: Requires valid observed window values. Expired windows are hidden; event refresh does not provide a continuous countdown.
guidance.requirements.warm_cache: Requires an observed warm cache with a future expiry. Local TTL does not guarantee the next server cache hit.
guidance.requirements.fast_mode: Appears when the official fast-mode flag is active.
guidance.requirements.thinking: Appears when the official extended-thinking flag is enabled.
guidance.requirements.agent_mode: Requires agent metadata from a --agent session.
guidance.requirements.vim_mode: Requires an observed Vim mode; hiding the built-in Vim indicator is a separate host setting.
guidance.requirements.context_observatio: Requires current context fields. Current-context tokens include input/cache occupancy and exclude output tokens.
guidance.reasons.unsupported_host: A verified host version requirement is not met.
guidance.reasons.unknown_host_version: The host version could not be determined.
guidance.reasons.source_unavailable: The required source cannot be read or does not provide a valid value.
guidance.reasons.condition_not_met: A display condition, such as the relevant mode or repository context, is absent.
guidance.reasons.runtime_disabled: Advanced collection is disabled or unavailable.
guidance.reasons.wait_coverage_missing: User-wait boundaries are not fully observed.
guidance.reasons.stale: The observation is too old for a current value.
guidance.reasons.incomplete: Event or request coverage is incomplete.
guidance.reasons.ambiguous_owner: The task or agent ownership cannot be established.
guidance.reasons.observed_only: Only a recent snapshot, rather than a verified live value, is available.
guidance.reasons.missing_stream: The real content stream is missing.
guidance.reasons.synthetic_response: A synthesized response cannot establish real stream timing or usage.
guidance.reasons.abnormal_clock: Clock evidence is inconsistent or unavailable.
guidance.reasons.request_join_unavailabl: The request cannot be reliably joined to its task or cost observation.
review.title: Review import
review.intro: Candidate only: accept replaces the draft; save separately to persist.
review.empty: No differences from the current draft.
review.accepted: Imported candidate accepted into the draft. Save explicitly to persist.
review.cancelled: Import review cancelled; previous draft kept.
review.stale: The draft changed while reading the import. Review the file again.
